card.name: "to" or "with" after allergy-history terms
card.fires_on: The small words "to" or "with" right after "sensitivity", "anaphylaxis" or "desensitizing treatment" in allergy warnings. It marks the point where the allergen is about to be named.

modes.label: History of sensitivity to
modes.description: "to" after "history of sensitivity" or "anaphylaxis", before multiple allergens or foods.
modes.example: a history of sensitivity<< to>> multiple allergens.

modes.label: Desensitizing treatment with
modes.description: "with" after "desensitizing treatment" before the venom name.
modes.example: Two patients undergoing desensitizing treatment<< with>> hymenoptera venom while receiving ACE
